blurbs.aboutMe:
Hey! I'm a software engineer who likes building things that feel good to use — the kind of small details most people never notice but would miss immediately if they were gone. Mostly full-stack web work these days. I care about clean interfaces, fast feedback loops, and code the next person can actually read.

When I'm not shipping, I'm usually taking something apart to see how it works, or losing an evening to a rabbit hole about interface design history. This site is one of those rabbit holes.
blurbs.whoIdLikeToMeet:
Engineers and designers who sweat the details. People building weird, delightful things on the web that don't look like everything else. Teams that care about craft and ship anyway.

Also: anyone who still remembers what it felt like to customize a profile page with hand-written CSS at 2am.

interests.label: General
interests.value: Cooking badly and eating well. Long walks with a podcast on. Board games with too many rules. Taking photos of buildings nobody else finds interesting.

interests.label: Music
interests.value: Whatever's loud enough to drown out an open-plan office. Currently on a heavy 2000s indie kick I'm not apologising for.

interests.label: Movies
interests.value: Sci-fi with practical effects, heist films, and anything where the production design is doing more work than the plot.

interests.label: Television
interests.value: Documentaries about things I'll never do — deep sea salvage, competitive baking, restoring old arcade cabinets.

interests.label: Books
interests.value: Non-fiction about how things got made. Design history, engineering disasters, and the occasional novel I'll take three months to finish.

interests.label: Heroes
interests.value: Anyone who documents their work properly. My grandmother. The person who first decided software should have an undo button.
